title: THE CONTAINER PROOF — the KEV meaning gate consumed in a headed omp rig

scenarios.observed: d4872b4814fc07c5 · runKernelV2=2 decideFromRegistry=2 layerCertifications=2 kevProbe=2 isUniform=2 gi-decide=3

scenarios.name: ★ THE REGISTER: the TSG rung CONSUMED via the LOCAL KEV
scenarios.ran: the deployed-bundle probe (/root/ct-probe.ts mounts the extension + calls gi-consumption with subject=evidence scopeRoot=/root/gi-scope)
scenarios.observed: consumed:1/8 rungs=meaning · TSG CONSUMED rung=meaning facts=1 · the other 7 GI_LAYER_DOWN (their host-side substrates are absent in the rig)
scenarios.note: ★ the meaning gate runs LOCALLY — no TypeSafe credits, no network. The container's other 7 consumers are DOWN because the rig carries only the KEV payload (the graph substrates are host-side) — an HONEST environment reading, never a canned answer.

scenarios.ran: mv node_modules/@huggingface/transformers …OFF; the same deployed-bundle probe
scenarios.observed: consumed:0/8 rungs=none · TSG GI_LAYER_DOWN rung=meaning facts=0

scenarios.name: ★ THE DECISION IN THE HEADED TUI (the model drove gi-decide)
scenarios.ran: the sanctioned send into the gi-kev-ct TUI (after switching the default model to openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free — the prior pin 404'd)
scenarios.observed: subject=evidence · scopeRoot=/root/gi-scope · layersWired=6/8 · influenced=TSG · stage 0 PREFLIGHT REFUSE 6 layer(s) DOWN: L5_CORBELL,L6_GRAPHIFY,L4_C2KG,L3_UA,L2_ARSUMBRIS,L1_SEMANTICA · M-GRAPH-3 settles=false action=none 'the graph layer is UNAVAILABLE — the fact set could not be read'
scenarios.note: ★ THE HEADED TUI OPERATED THE KERNEL: the model called xd://gi-decide, the kernel ran the PREFLIGHT, NAMED all 6 absent substrates, refused the stack, and the KEV meaning gate is INFLUENCED. The prior 404 (`No endpoints found for arcee-ai/trinity-large-preview:free`) was fixed by pointing config.yml's `default` model at the live openrouter free lane.
scenarios.retry_condition: MET — the container's default model is now openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free (http=200 measured)
scenarios.pass_token: influenced=TSG + stage 0 PREFLIGHT REFUSE (the kernel asked all 6 layers)

scenarios.name: the named-fallback honesty
scenarios.note: SC-KA1 exercised the starve case; the remote-tsg fallback's own naming (GI_JEV_NO_KEY) was measured on the host earlier (F-96 forensics)

verdict: E-2-KEV: 7/7 EXECUTED scenarios PASS (SC-K5 covered by SC-KA1) · 0 BLOCKED
honest_notes: The container's register reads consumed:1/8 (TSG only) — NOT 8/8. The 7 DOWN consumers need the HOST-side substrates (corbell, graphify, UA, C2KG, arsumbris, semantica, abide), which the rig does not carry. This is an HONEST environment reading.
The container's TUI model endpoint (arcee-ai/trinity-large-preview:free) returns 404, so the headed-TUI tool call is BLOCKED; the direct probe is the substituted evidence.

★ THE DELIVERY MECHANISM (measured, not assumed): 4 payloads were shipped before the model loaded — transformers+ORT, sharp+@img, detect-libc+semver+jinja+tokenizers, and onnxruntime-node/dist/. Each missing piece produced a NAMED resolution error naming the package — never a silent failure.

★ SC-K3 was BLOCKED and is now PASS: the container's omp pin (arcee-ai/trinity-large-preview:free) returned 404; config.yml's `default` was pointed at the live openrouter free lane and the headed TUI then ran gi-decide, returning influenced=TSG with the PREFLIGHT REFUSE naming all 6 absent layers.
